# Rate limits

Default plan: 600 requests/minute, burst 50.
Burst is token-bucket with 1 refill/second.

Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch seconds).
429 responses must be retried with Retry-After; ignoring it results in a 24h suspension.

New: per-endpoint budgets. /v2/search is 60/min, /v2/export is 6/min.
Legacy /v1 endpoints are removed on 2027-01-15.

2026-09-20  v2.9  Added per-endpoint budgets for /v2/search and /v2/export.

2026-07-02  v2.6  Added X-RateLimit-Reset as epoch seconds.

turns.decision: Placeholders are not labels - both inputs need real <label> elements, and the close button cannot be aria-hidden while focusable.
turns.summary: Audit: 3 violations (2 missing labels, 1 aria-hidden focusable). SignupForm.tsx uses placeholder-as-label and an aria-hidden close button.

turns.user: Fix all three violations properly.
turns.thinking: Add visible labels tied by htmlFor, and remove aria-hidden from the close button so screen readers can reach it.

input.old_string:
<input id="email" name="email" type="email" placeholder="Email" />
      <input id="password" name="password" type="password" placeholder="Password" />

<label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
      <input id="email" name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" />
      <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
      <input id="password" name="password" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" />
      <button className="close" aria-label="Close" onClick={close}>x</button>
